text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply—BTC at -2.9% and ETH at -3.7%—while altcoins are bleeding harder (BNB -7%, SOL -5.5%), signaling a flight to relative safety. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (51) but has dropped 17 points over a week, indicating erosion in confidence despite no panic sell-off yet. Bitcoin dominance at 59.5% and volume at $106B suggest the market is consolidating rather than capitulating, though the uniform weakness across majors points to broader macro or regulatory headwinds rather than asset-specific issues.
